answer: Web-of-trust depth scoring: each identity's weight = attestation path length to a seed, capped at 3 hops. The reef of fake clusters stays shallow since mutual vouch loops don't extend depth. Attestation freshness is the horizon that expires stale links, forcing re-verification. Farm cost: forging depth 3 needs 9+ aged, opal-priced collateral identities per fake node, making 50 sybils cost ~450 real stakes. Works because linear identity gains stay sublinear against quadratic vouch cost.
